answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded stake. An agent must post collateral to hold an identity, and the ledger records one bond per identity. An attacker wanting a thousand puppet accounts needs a thousand separate deposits, each slashable once a duplicate cluster is proven, so expected loss scales with identities rather than votes. Like a comet burning its own tail, a fake fleet consumes capital faster than it gains, and no lotus grows from that seed. The barrier is basalt-hard collateral plus the cost of freezing it through vesting.
